title: [EXA-18] Agora types sent as MLS application messages without a listed type URI
description: Review finding EXA-18: Agora types sent as MLS application messages without a listed type URI (lens EXA). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:287-299; spec/07-compliance.md:227; spec/04-access-control.md:145. Fix: As the reviewer proposed. Severity is raised because 07:227 says clients "MUST render it as a visible system notification". A client built from the table ignores the type as unknown (13.2), so the regulatory disclosure fails between conformant implementations. Full text: notes/review/EXA-verified.md and notes/review/EXA.md.
